description: Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka  - Declare the Jaffna, Batiicaloa and Rathmalana Airports for International Operations
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the opening of domestic airports for regional commercial flights under "THE AIR NAVIGATION REGULATION OF 1955" and references the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It establishes regulatory frameworks, operational procedures, and compliance requirements for aviation operations, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or other specialized category.
